summary.intent: Run the GSD manager dashboard to discuss Phase 51 (Crypto-Signature & Secret-Leak Hardening) and Phase 52 (Desktop FUSE Durability), with Phase 51 planning running as a background agent while Phase 52 discussion proceeds inline.
summary.outcome: Phase 51 discuss completed with scope narrowed to IPNS S1/S2/S3 only (Faro/logging todo #15 dropped). Phase 52 discuss completed with decisions captured. Phase 51 planning restarted in an isolated worktree after being interrupted by a session limit.

repo: GSD commit helper auto-switches the main working tree's branch on the first phase commit (main → feat/<slug>), which means a background planner running in the shared tree gets its branch yanked when a second phase commits
core.hooksPath in this repo is an absolute path pointing to the main tree's .husky directory, so worktrees inherit the same pre-commit hooks and require their own node_modules (pnpm i) to run them

init.manager dep-parser misreads 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' as deps [49, '1.1'], causing phases 51–55 to report deps_satisfied: false and producing an empty recommended_actions list even though all five are unblocked
Phase 50 reported is_active: true in init.manager query despite being marked [x] completed 2026-06-19 in ROADMAP — stale active flag from the query layer

Todo #15 (logger redaction + Faro transport) was originally scoped to Phase 51 but dropped: the redact() interceptor has no security value without a remote transport, and acceptance criteria require Faro to verify — deferred to a future observability phase

Phase 51 HARD-02 scope narrowed to three IPNS signed-record items only: S1 embedded-vs-DTO anti-rollback, S2 fail-closed verification, S3 exhaustive key zeroization across SDK + Rust unwrap paths with lint/test guard

code.finding: Phase 51 todo HARD-02 and Phase 52 todo #9 both live under .planning/todos/pending/; the initial CONTEXT.md wrote a stale path that the planner was supposed to fix

Phase 43 review has 5 remaining open warnings (criticals already fixed in prior phases); Phase 52 scope is to close these — IN-04 (scrub C:\Users\, /var, /tmp, /private + drive-letter in sanitize_error), IN-05 (log::warn! on swallowed journal.remove() errors)
Contains stale canonical-ref path for todo HARD-02; the restarted planner was tasked with correcting it as part of its first commit

workflow: The manager workflow's guardrail stating background agents on Claude Code cannot nest sub-agents is incorrect — the general-purpose and claude subagent types have Tools: * including the Agent tool, so a backgrounded agent can nest the full plan pipeline (researcher, pattern-mapper, plan-checker)

Agent() calls for background planning must explicitly set isolation: 'worktree' to prevent branch collisions; without it the agent runs in the shared working tree and any GSD commit helper auto-branch-switch corrupts its working state
Symlinking node_modules into a worktree is fragile; pnpm i in the worktree is the correct approach for proper isolated deps when the shared tree's hooks need to run
TaskStop stops a background agent cleanly between tool calls — the stopped agent had not committed, so no rollback was needed
GSD commit helper false-negative: reports commit_failed but the commit actually lands; always verify with git log after seeing that error

friction: init.manager dep-parser bug treats '(v1.1 baseline)' parenthetical as a dep named '1.1', producing phantom unsatisfied deps and emptying recommended_actions for all five hardening phases
Phase 50 stale is_active flag in init.manager output required manual dashboard correction — the query layer didn't pick up the ROADMAP completion marker
Phase 51 planner launched without isolation: 'worktree', requiring a full stop-relaunch cycle with worktree setup before Phase 52 could commit safely
The manager workflow's documented constraint about Claude Code background agents not being able to nest sub-agents is wrong, causing unnecessary discussion and a delayed start
Session limit interrupted the Phase 51 background planner during its first run (~31s in, just after pnpm i completed), requiring a restart
Worktree had no node_modules, making the stale-path fix in CONTEXT.md impossible to commit cleanly without pnpm i first — workaround was to revert the edit and let the planner handle it
open_items: Phase 51 background planner was restarted but not confirmed complete at session end — verify plan landed in feat/crypto-signature-secret-leak-hardening worktree
Phase 52 CONTEXT written and committed but planning not yet started
Phases 53 (Release & Supply-Chain), 54 (E2E Test-Infra Typing), 55 (Large Source-File Refactor) not yet discussed
Todo #15 (logger redaction + Faro transport wiring) deferred to a future observability phase — needs its own phase entry in the roadmap eventually
init.manager dep-parser bug (misreads parenthetical version labels as dependency IDs) should be fixed in gsd-tools to avoid false-blocked recommendations on future milestones
Phase 51 CONTEXT.md stale canonical-ref path needs correction (the restarted planner was supposed to fix it as its first commit)
Manager workflow documentation should be updated to reflect that Claude Code background agents CAN nest sub-agents, removing the misleading guardrail
